channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Slaughtneil keep it to script against St John's to retain Ulster club SHC title
item.description: Slaughtneil made it back-to-back Ulster club senior hurling championship titles thanks to a comprehensive 0-23 to 0-10 victory against St John's at the Box-It Athletic Grounds this evening.

item.title: Carrickmore down Lisbellaw for first Ulster club IHC crown
item.description: Eire Og Carrickmore (Tyrone) are Ulster club intermediate hurling champions thanks to a 1-18 to 0-15 win against Lisbellaw (Fermanagh) in Clones this afternoon.

item.title: "It wouldn't feel right not to mention the late Don Connellan on a day like today"
item.description: St Brigid's joint captain Paul McGrath paid tribute to the late Don Connellan after his team's Connacht club SFC final victory this afternoon.

item.title: Ladies: Kilkerrin-Clonberne cruise past Comeragh Rangers to another All-Ireland club SFC final
item.description: Kilkerrin-Clonberne's 'Drive for Five' is still on after a eleven-point win over Comeragh Rangers booked their place in the AIB All-Ireland Senior Club Championship final in two weeks.

item.title: Ladies: St Ergnat's Moneyglass upset Kilmacud Crokes to reach first All-Ireland senior decider
item.description: Cathy Carey and Maria O'Neill were in excellent form at Pairc de Burca as history-makers St Ergnat's Moneyglass booked their spot in the forthcoming AIB All-Ireland senior club championship final with a superb victory over Kilmacud Crokes.

item.title: Ladies: Pairings confirmed for All-Ireland club senior, intermediate and junior finals
item.description: Kilkerrin-Clonberne remain on course for a fifth AIB All-Ireland SFC club title in a row after they defeated Waterford champions Comeragh Rangers by 1-11 to 0-3 in the semi-final.

item.title: Fallon goal key as St Brigid's claim sixth Connacht club SFC title
item.description: St Brigid's edged out Moycullen by 1-16 to 1-14 at Dr Hyde Park this afternoon to claim their sixth Connacht club senior football championship crown.

item.title: Ballygunner dominate against Éire Óg Ennis for record sixth Munster club SHC success
item.description: Ballygunner landed their sixth Munster club senior hurling championship title with an empathic 0-21 to 1-9 win over Éire Óg Ennis at FBD Semple Stadium this afternoon.

item.title: Scotstown KO Newbridge after penalty shootout to advance to Ulster club SFC final
item.description: Scotstown will play Kilcoo in the Ulster club senior football championship final next Saturday week, December 13th, after coming through an epic against Sean O'Learys Newbridge at the Box-it Athletic Grounds this evening.
